verdict.rationale: Orama ships a fully open-source engine (vector, hybrid, full-text, facets, typo tolerance) that runs entirely in-process/keylessly (orama-probe-rt-1, orama-gh-2), and docs state its APIs are 'designed to be as close as possible' to Orama Cloud's so projects can migrate either way (orama-docs-19, orama-docs-29). Orama also explicitly offers on-premise deployment of the Cloud context server (orama-docs-8). However, some hosted-product features like the Secure Proxy for AnswerSession and auto-provisioned MCP server are described as Cloud-specific conveniences (orama-docs-18, orama-docs-20), leaving imperfect feature parity. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that MCP server, Secure Proxy, and all Cloud-only conveniences are also self-hostable with identical configuration, and independent verification of full parity at scale.
